success_rules.compute_path_to_pose: wrapped.status == STATUS_SUCCEEDED AND result is not None AND result.error_code == ComputePathToPose.Result.NONE (0) AND path contains at least one pose
success_rules.navigate_to_pose: wrapped.status == STATUS_SUCCEEDED AND result is not None AND result.error_code == NavigateToPose.Result.NONE (0)

compute_path_result_mapping.other_nonzero_error_code: PLANNER_FAILURE when the result is invalid

navigate_result_mapping.explicit_local_navigation_timeout: TIMEOUT; the wrapper cancels the goal after navigation_timeout_s (default 240 s)
navigate_result_mapping.explicit_no_progress_timeout: CONTROLLER_NO_PROGRESS; the wrapper cancels after navigation_no_progress_timeout_s (default 30 s since last >=0.05 m progress)
navigate_result_mapping.recovery_exhaustion: not separately distinguished; it remains UNKNOWN unless the local no-progress watchdog was the direct evidence
navigate_result_mapping.dynamic_blockage: not produced by current LocalNav2; the enum exists but no dynamic_obstacle_confirmed evidence is set

association.canonical_effect: a canonical task is blocked when any member physical_signature is currently suppressed
association.spatial_tolerance: none at failure-memory lookup; the signature itself was generated from 0.05 m quantized approach, centroid and bounds
association.per_robot_or_team: team-visible in effect: both peers subscribe to both /robotN/exploration_failure topics and each keeps its own local copy; the failing peer records local evidence before publishing
association.alternative_approach: the transport message has no alternative_approach field; the unused pure FailureSuppressor supports it only in unit-testable infrastructure

allocator_suppression.first_hard_failure: record immediately with requested TTL 15 s
allocator_suppression.expiry: _expire_failures removes entries when receiver-local time exceeds expiry; map revision does not explicitly clear this table

candidate_generator_suppression.key: stable frontier uint64 ID from quantized geometry/bounds/size
candidate_generator_suppression.goal_occupied_or_outside_map: persist until a different map revision is observed

gate_or_penalty.current_behavior: hard failure is already a feasibility/suppression gate in _task_feasible; the nominal -5 score term is unreachable for selected feasible assignments
gate_or_penalty.safe_rewrite_direction: preserve the exact-signature bounded TTL gate; remove hard_failure from the soft exploration objective and retain failure diagnostics

map_change_risk.reason: allocator suppression is bounded to at most 120 s and candidate-generator persistent suppression is released on a changed map revision
map_change_risk.remaining_risk: an unchanged physical signature can be temporarily unavailable even if a newly changed map would make it useful; the next allocator should keep the bounded expiry and consider a changed-map/signature version if reopening sooner is required
